ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, filled buttons (Be Pro), dark floating nav rail, icons, input borders, table borders

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, button labels, badge text, image backgrounds, content panels

canvas.$description: Canvas — Page background, card borders, section fills — the warm gray that makes the whole surface feel printed rather than digital

fog.$description: Fog — Secondary borders, icon strokes, list dividers, subtle structural lines

smoke.$description: Smoke — Table borders, hairline dividers, muted structural lines

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary surfaces, link backgrounds in compact contexts, darker fills for nested elements

ember.$description: Ember — Sporadic accent — appears as a single-color punctuation mark on rare UI elements and score indicators; the only chromatic color in the system, used sparingly to draw the eye

inter-tight.$description: The sole typeface. Weight 300 at 127px with 0.75 line-height for the project display title — the condensed, light weight lets 'ODD RITUAL' occupy the full viewport width as a single typographic gesture. Weight 400 covers body, nav, badges. Weight 500–600 for buttons, labels, and emphasis. The extreme size range (9px metadata to 127px display) within one family creates a deliberate mono-typographic system where hierarchy is scale, not style.
